in_sanskrit.name: Preksha
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: to see, to behold, to observe, to perceive, to understand, to contemplate, to ponder, to scrutinize, to examine, to inspect, to observe closely, to gaze at, to watch, to look, to behold with the mind, to have insight into

in_tamil.name: Pirekshā
in_tamil.meaning: to see, to observe, to perceive, to understand

in_marathi.name: Preksha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Preksha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The act of seeing or observing with deep introspection, often during meditation

in_bengali.name: Preksha
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ View, Sight
in_bengali.long_meaning: Preksha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The act of seeing or observing with deep introspection, often during meditation
